topics.title: Clinton Discusses Russia & Fantasies
topics.summary: During this broadcast, President Clinton discusses difficulties in resolving economic issues within Russia while recounting a personal incident involving reporters and inappropriate comments about his desires. The conversation shifts to an unsolicited discussion of fantasies regarding Richard Gere before addressing concerns about Robin's departure from the program.

topics.title: Breast Surgery Discussion
topics.summary: During an informal conversation, several individuals discuss speculation about cosmetic surgery involving a woman’s breasts, referencing potential augmentations around '87 and questioning whether it was performed before a Playboy layout. The discussion then shifts to broader opinions on beauty standards and racial identity.

topics.title: Cancellation Concerns and Market Volatility
topics.summary: A television show faces widespread cancellation due to perceived inappropriate content, with concerns raised about its impact on children. Simultaneously, the Dow Jones Industrial Average experiences fluctuations amid investor anxieties regarding market stability and trading activity.

topics.title: Political Discussions and Personal Reflections
topics.summary: Amidst investor anxieties and the Monica Lewinsky controversy, discussions center on President Clinton's credibility and apologies. Senator Trent Lott expresses doubts about his leadership while others advocate for continued support; personal anecdotes regarding marriage troubles are interspersed with political commentary.

topics.title: President Discusses Lewinsky Apology & Legal Case
topics.summary: During an interview, the President dismisses further apologies regarding Monica Lewinsky and discusses a potential role for her on ‘Days of Our Lives.’ Separately, a doctor is charged with attempting to terminate his girlfriend’s pregnancy via injection, leading to hospital treatment.

topics.title: Storm Warning & Name Changes
topics.summary: During a discussion about an approaching tropical storm in Northwestern Florida, a man named Fred abruptly changes his name to Eric following an argument. Later, the conversation shifts to listener concerns regarding their child watching 'Titanic' and offers of edited versions available for purchase from a video store.
